name: Complementary Relation Framing
description: Shifts the definition of the target structure from a positive property of the given edges (e.g., all pairs collide) to a negative property of missing edges (e.g., no pair is independent). Models relying on surface pattern matching for cliques may fail to invert the logic or incorrectly attempt to search the complement graph, while reasoning models will correctly deduce that lacking independent pairs means all pairs must be collisions.
